arabic text: BANO SE AAKE KHWAB ME KEHTA THA SHEER KHWAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAAS HUN.
english translation text: THE BABY WOULD APPEAR IN BANO’S DREAM AND TELL HER…'O\nMOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: FURQAT ME MERI YOON NA KARO DIL KO BEQARAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN.
english translation text: 'DON’T GET RESTLESS AT MY SEPARATION FROM YOU'.\n'O MOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: PANI KI EK BOOND BHI MAI PA BHI NAHI SAKA,\nMAQTAL SE KHAIMA GAH MAI AA BHI NAHI SAKA
english translation text: I WAS NOT GIVEN A SINGLE DROP OF WATER…\nI WAS NOT ABLE TO RETURN TO THE TENTS FROM THE BATTLE FIELD…

arabic text: TUMKO GALE KA ZAKHM DIKHA BHI NAHI SAKA,\nZALIM KA TEER HO GAYA GARDAN K AAR PAAR.\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: I WAS NOT ABLE TO SHOW YOU MY PIERCED THROAT…\nTHE PERPETRATOR’S ARROW TORE ACROSS MY NECK\n'O MOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: AAKAR JO MERE HALQ PE TEER E SITAM LAGA,\nSUKHE GALE SE KHOON KA CHASHMA UBAL PADA
english translation text: THE MOMENT THE ARROW STRUCK MY THROAT…\nTHERE WAS A FOUNTAIN OF BLOOD THAT GUSHED OUT…

arabic text: CHULLU ME LEKE BABA NE CHEHRE PE MAL LIA,\nACHA HUA KI TUMNE NA DEKHI WO KHOO'N KI DHAAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: MY FATHER TOOK THE BLOOD IN IS HANDS AND WIPED HIS FACE WITH IT…I AM GRATEFUL THAT YOU DID NOT WITNESS THIS HORRIFIC SCENE.\n'O MOTHER,\nI AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: TABDEEL MERI PYAS KA MANZAR NA HO SAKA,\nTHA KHUSHQ HALQ KHUSHQ RAHA TAR NA HO SAKA
english translation text: THE STATUS OF MY THIRST NEVER CHANGED…\nMY THROAT WAS DRY AND REMAINED AS SUCH…

arabic text: TURBAT ME BHI SUKOON MAYASSAR NA HO SAKA\nNAIZE SE ZALIMO'N NE UKHARA MERA MAZAAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: I HAD NO PEACE EVEN IN MY GRAVE, THE\nENEMIES EVEN DUG ME OUT OF MY GRAVE…'O\nMOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: PEHLE KIA SHAHEED MUJHE TEER MAAR KAR\nPHERI GALE PE TEGH LEHED SE NIKAL KAR
english translation text: FIRST THE ENEMIES KILLED ME WITH THE ARROW…\nTHEN THEY SLIT MY THROAT AFTER TAKING ME OUT OF MY GRAVE…

arabic text: PHIR NAIZE PE CHADHAYA GAYA HAYE MERA SAR,\nMUJH PAR SITAM KIYE HAIN LAYEENO'N NE BAAR BAAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: AFTER THAT, THEY PUT MY HEAD ON A SPEAR…\nTHE ENEMIES HAVE TORTURED ME OVER AND OVER.\n'O MOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: AAYA JO KHAIMA GAH SE BABA KI GOD ME,\nPHIR JA NA PAYA BALI SAKINA KI GOD ME
english translation text: WHEN I CAME BACK FROM THE BATTLEFIELD IN MY BABA’S ARMS,\nI WAS NOT ABLE TO GO MY SISTER SAKINA

arabic text: JATA WATAN TO KHELTA BEHNA KI GOD ME,\nTAQDEER PAR RAHA HAI BHALA KISKA IKHTIYAR.\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: HAD I GONE BACK TO MADINA,\nI WOULD HAVE PLAYED IN MY SISTER’S LAP. ALAS! WHO HAS CONTROL OVER DESTINY?\n'O MOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: MAHAUL DIL KHARASH THA QATL GAH ME,
english translation text: THE ATMOSPHERE WAS DEADLY IN THE BATTLE FIELD… ALL THE PERPETRATORS WERE INVOLVED IN THIS SIN… SARE GUNAH GAR THE SHAMIL GUNAH ME

arabic text: KHAYA KISI NE REHEM NA ZALIM SIPAH ME,\nMERI LEHAD BANA K BAHOT ROYI ZULFIQAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: NO ONE SHOWED MERCY ON ME…\nZULFIQAR CRIED PROFUSELY AFTER DIGGING MY GRAVE.\n'O MOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: SADMO'N NE MERA NANNA SA DIL CHOOR KAR DIA,\nTAQDEER NE BEHEN SE BAHOT DOOR KAR DIA
english translation text: CALAMITIES HAVE TORN APART MY LITTLE HEART…\nMY FATE HAS TAKEN ME FAR AWAY FROM MY SISTER…

arabic text: MAI KYA KAHUN KI MAUT NE MAJBOOR KAR DIA\nKEH DO SAKINA SE NA KARE MERA INTEZAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: HOW CAN I SAY THAT DEATH HAS MADE ME HELPLESS\nTELL SAKINA NOT TO WAIT FOR ME ANY MORE. 'O\nMOTHER, I AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'

arabic text: FAKHRI TERE KALAAM KI WO EHMIYAT NAHI,\nMEESUM TERE BAYAN ME WO KAIFIYAT NAHI
english translation text: O FAKHRI (POET), YOUR WRITING DOES NOT HAVE THE POWER…\nO MEESUM (RECITER) YOUR RECITATION DOES NOT HAVE THE POWER…

arabic text: US DARD KO SAMETNE KI HAISIYAT NAHI,\nJIS DARD SE TARAP K YE KEHTA THA SHEER KHWAR\nAY AMMA MAI DADI K PAS HUN
english translation text: TO ENCAPSULATE THE PAIN..\nWITH WHICH THE BABY WOULD TREMBLE AND SAY…'O MOTHER,\nI AM WITH MY GRANDMOTHER (BIBI FATIMA (A))'
